column1: # Game profile of Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu! (Switch, base game v0 + update 1.0.2 = v131072)
# PEANUTS: a Peanuts Native profile (Banana Native has none for this title); whole file Peanuts' own
# Game Freak's engine (the one before Sword's) on SDK 5.4.151, NVN, Wwise; subsdk0 is GLSLC (main does not import glslcCompile), subsdk1 the movie module.
# The shaders are BNSH files under bin/ (loose, in .arc archives and in GFPAK archives under bin/archive), in system_resource/shader and in main (shader_split.py).
# Status: provisional profile (dm/games/profile_guess.py from the survey); memory values not measured yet. README.md beside this file.
# handheld: past its first setup (main+0x38cdc, Pro Controller | Handheld | dual Joy-Cons) the game supports Handheld, the single Joy-Cons held upright and the Poké Ball Plus
# (SetSupportedNpadStyleSet 0x5a at main+0x14008c, then SetNpadJoyHoldType vertical and single assignment for No1 and No2), not the Pro Controller the host reports docked
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region (the survey's guess; Pokémon Sword's measured layout is the same)
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon
# 11,160 shaders of base game and 1.0.2: the BNSH of bin/ (8,357; GFPAK archives under bin/archive, .arc archives, loose files), system_resource/shader (33) and main (2,770)
# used memory for the current rewritten modules, at least the default 64 MB (the Android rewrite: main 32.6 MB, subsdk0 15.1 MB, sdk 13.3 MB, subsdk1 7.7 MB)
